checks: Simple Split Day lists matching activities without detailed-mode checkboxes.
Rest and None are distinct; explicit None overrides a weekday and restoring the default removes that override.
An extra logged activity does not check off an unrelated routine item.
Past session shows only recorded activities; opening it writes no sets, notes, or overrides.
A removed split is treated as unavailable.
Both real pre-routine March and October CSV formats import in isolated profiles; October preserves all 39 dated splits.
